name: Jaipur Walled City - clean
description: The UNESCO-listed walled city around the City Palace, where a single haveli is routinely a shop at street level and homes above it - the vertical property problem in its oldest form. Heights are capped by heritage bylaws, which is what makes an air right here worth arguing about.
